title: Lisbon, Portugal
excerpt: Golden-hour rooftops, tiled streets, and warm nights made for cinematic city wandering.
coverAlt: Romantic Lisbon travel illustration with warm evening colors

blocks.body:
## Why Lisbon stays with you
Lisbon feels effortless in the best way: bright facades, golden light, and a pace that still leaves room to linger. It is perfect for solo travelers who want beauty, culture, and elegant corners to discover at their own speed.

blocks.alt: Illustrated Lisbon postcard in burgundy and gold
blocks.caption: A warm city with a timeless glow.

blocks.text: Lisbon is the kind of city that turns an ordinary walk into a memory.
blocks.author: Iris

title: Puglia, Italy
excerpt: Stone alleys, coastal calm, and slow luxury moments along southern Italy's warm edges.

blocks.body:
## A softer side of adventure
Puglia blends understated luxury with small discoveries: quiet courtyards, textured stone, and sea views that reward slow mornings. It is the kind of destination that photographs beautifully and feels even better in person.

title: Mullerthal Trail, Luxembourg
excerpt: Forest paths, moody light, and a grounded adventure for the traveler who loves nature with atmosphere.
coverAlt: Misty forest trail illustration inspired by Luxembourg

blocks.body:
## For the traveler who wants movement
The Mullerthal Trail offers a quieter, more intimate kind of luxury: time, space, and the feeling of having a dramatic landscape unfold around you.

blocks.caption: Adventure, but with a romantic point of view.

title: Versailles, France
excerpt: Gilded interiors, dramatic symmetry, and a day trip that feels like stepping inside a painting.

blocks.body:
## Grandeur with a story
Versailles captures the refined side of travel: rich detail, iconic architecture, and the kind of visual drama that pairs naturally with editorial-style storytelling.

blocks.caption: A classic stop for timeless imagery.
